raw_segments.text: Grandpray, why do you stay so long, my lords of France?
Yond island carrions, desperate of their bones, ill-favorably become the morning field.
Their ragged curtains poorly are let loose, and our air shakes them passing scornfully.
Big Mars seems bankrupt in their beggared host, and faintly through a rusty beaver peeps.
The horsemen sit like fixed candlesticks with torch staves in their hand, and their poor
jades lob down their heads, drooping the hides and hips, the gum down roping from their
pale dead eyes, and in their pale dull mouths the gimel bit lies foul with chewed grass,
still and motionless, and their executors, the navish crows, fly o'er them, all impatient
Description cannot suit itself in words to demonstrate the life of such a battle, in life
so lifeless as it shows itself.
